author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Once you ban human from writing code and reading the code, every line must be written and test by AI.    You liberated yourself from many human constraints in selecting your programming language and frameworks.

1. Boiler plate, who cares?  It is actually better to lock down what AI can or cannot do with boiler plate

2. Strong type and linting is always better

3. Fast run time and debug turn around time, absolutely.   AI speed is different than human speed

4. Synthetic sugar to make the code easier for human to read - VERY BAD.   AI don't care about 10 level deep for loop or 5 pages long if-else statement.  AI can read it and understand it pretty well.

5. Everything in one file, why not?  AI has 1M context window.  The lesser files to read the better.

What is good and what's bad in programing has flipped upside down.
